scripts.dev:backend: cd ClauseGuard-backend && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.dev:rag: cd ClauseGuard-rag && source venv/bin/activate && python run.py
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:rag"
scripts.install:all: cd ClauseGuard-frontend && npm install && cd ../ClauseGuard-backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../ClauseGuard-rag && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
